info.title: API.SH: Fashionphile
info.description: The Fashionphile API from API.SH: public Fashionphile data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Every brand in the Fashionphile shop with its live item count (optionally within a collection), most items first, with a ready search link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fashionphile-brands

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Only items in this collection.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Brand name contains.

parameters.name: available_only
parameters.description: Count only items in stock.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One product with price, condition, stock, description, tags, images and variants. With `details=true` it also returns `details`: `condition_grade`, `condition_notes` (label and value, e.g. Exterior: corner wear), `included_items` (what it comes with, e.g. dust bag, box, certificate of authenticity), `item_number`, `year` and `measurements` (label and value, e.g. Base length: 11.5 in, Drop: 7 in).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fashionphile-product

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: true: also return the product page's detail blocks as `details` (measurements, condition notes, included items, item number, year). Costs more.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fashionphile-search

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Collection handle to search within.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand(s), comma separated (e.g. Chanel, Hermes, Louis Vuitton). Values and counts for the current search are in the response `facets`; comma lists match any.

parameters.name: condition

parameters.description: USD.

parameters.name: max_price

parameters.name: available_only
parameters.description: Only items still for sale (the index also holds sold items).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Result order: relevance (default), price_asc (cheapest first), price_desc (most expensive first) or oldest (oldest listings first). The response echoes it as `sort`.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
